figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 3. Amount of taxa-4,11-diene (mg/L) β-caryophyllene equivalent and 
cell growth of B. subtilis strains with individual genes from MEP pathway

formed in triplicate. Bars represent Mean ± SD, n = 3. For detailed explanation

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 4. Relative expression level of dxs gene in B. subtilis strains. The in­
dividual data points are displayed as dots. Two biological (n = 2) and four 
technical (n = 4) replicates were used for each strain. For detailed explanation 
of strain names used, see Table S1.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 5. Western blot of the soluble protein fraction showing fused PTs 
expressed in B. subtilis 168. The lanes show fused PTs bands of ALE, FLE, ELA, 
ELF from left to right, resulting from expression at a temperature of 20 ◦C. The 
enzyme was visualized by using specific antibodies against the His-tag.

figure_candidates.caption:

names used, see Table S1.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 7
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 7. (A) Schematic representation of the integrative vector and plasmids used in the txs þ 8 þ dxs_FLE strain. Previously constructed shuttle plasmid 
pDR111_txs contains spectinomycin (emerald green) and ampicillin resistance cassettes (light apricot) with txs gene under IPTG-inducible hyperspank promoter 
(purple), txs gene was introduced by recombination into the nonessential amyE locus (brown) of the chromosomal DNA as a single copy. The pBS0E plasmids induced 
by xylose-inducible promoter, dxs were expressed on a pBS0E plasmid with xylose-inducible promoter (black) in combination with the fpps-(GGGGS)3-crtE gene, 
preceded by B. subtilis mntA RBS and erythromycin (wathet blue) and ampicillin resistance cassettes. pHCMC04_SDFHCEGA contains seven genes of the MEP 
pathway, dxs, ispD, ispF, ispH, ispC, ispE, and ispG, along with the gene ispA (apricot), each preceded by B. subtilis mntA ribosomal binding site (dark red), in a 
synthetic operon controlled by xylose inducible promoter (black) and ampicillin (light apricot) and chloramphenicol resistance cassettes (yellow). (B) Time-course 
profile of txs þ 8 þ dxs_FLE strain. Taxadiene production (black line) and cell density (dash line) of B. subtilis cultured in 2SR at different time points were 
detected. The experiment was performed in triplicate. Bars represent Mean ± SD, n = 3 (C) Amount of taxa-4,11-diene (mg/L) β-caryophyllene equivalent and 
cell growth comparison of dxs overexpression strains with and without fusion PTs. Taxadiene was collected from 48 h culture. The experiment was performed 
in triplicate. For detailed explanation of strain names used, see Table S1.
